row_order: merged.parquet rowid order == row order of every v21fit probe csv and of submission_blend_newbest_v21_w10_20261031.csv.zip; n=529390

EN.source: erbrown/w10an/eb_new_rank.npy (EB-new rank, ErBrown latest, public 0.828856; recovered as (W-0.1*O)/0.9 from submission_blend_newbest_v21_w10)

E0.source: rank-normalised M["eb"] of erbrown/merged.parquet = nr(eb) (ErBrown prior submission_best, public .824558); nr(x)=(rankdata(x)-1)/(n-1)

A_all.source: v21fit/A_all.npy = v21seq A _all (8 seeds ctl6 listwise MLP + 3 history-model seeds), rank-normalised

D_dcn.source: v21fit/D_dcn.npy = regularised DCN-v2, mean of 4 members (dcn6 s0, dcn6b s1, dcn7 s0, dcn4 s0, C27 eval), rank-normalised, built by mkD.py

v8regen.source: v21fit/inv_v8regen.npy = nr(predicted_probability) of v12x/v8regen/submission_v8_regen.csv.zip aligned to merged rowid order

v5.source: v21fit/inv_v5.npy = nr(predicted_probability) of v5/submission_v5.csv.zip aligned to merged rowid order

P_p33.role: fit-only (binormal/Monte Carlo scripts addon*.py, reopt*.py, recal.py)

S_ebdistill.source: v21fit/S_ebdistill.npy = EBDISTILL student (trained on EB-new pseudo labels)

R0.source: v21fit/R0.npy = 10x10 rank-correlation matrix (subsample 200k rows) of EN,E0,A,D,P,v5,v8r,S,slB,listA in this order (inputs of addon.py)
